planned_owned_files.role: Immutable field observations/copy provenance, source liveness, stage/severity incidents and recovery; exact affected-interval union; operation-specific field support; bounded identity/checkpoint state.
Per-operation/per-field materialized eligibility intervals and explicit joint snapshots; bounded index; PIT supplied-universe union and exact reported-known-OI coverage.
Independent finite full-scan observation/liveness/incident and join reference; no reuse of challenger query selection or interval lookup. Canonical dataclasses may be shared.
Finite contract, field propagation/recovery, full-versus-incremental, source-scope analogue and real timed toy telemetry cases; consume frozen golden.

api_contracts.name: FieldKey
api_contracts.contract: Frozen producer/field/instrument/definition identity plus source-capability and coverage coordinates. No key/list of present fields claims a complete contract universe.

api_contracts.name: FieldFact
api_contracts.contract: Frozen id,key,payload_json,observed_at,Clocks,source_version,revision,available_operations,optional content_origin_id. Validate immutable payload and exact identity. Copies must match an admitted origin key/value/economic clock/definition; local receipt may advance, source observation/value-change/liveness may not.

api_contracts.name: SourceLiveness
api_contracts.contract: Frozen source/scope/evidenceID,source_observed_at,known_at,health and declared stream kind/cadence evidence. Latest available evidence only; no new liveness inferred from copying or absence of trades.

api_contracts.name: QualityIncident / QualityRecovery
api_contracts.contract: Frozen raw-or-semantic stage, exact affected fields and observation interval, known_at, severity, operations, cause and source evidence. Incident scopes distinguish present book state and historical flow support. Recovery requires matching incident/field/evidence; never deletes past interval or unrelated flow incident.

api_contracts.name: OperationPolicy
api_contracts.contract: Frozen policyID/version, operation, max_economic_age_ns, optional explicit max_source_silence_ns, max_clock_uncertainty_ns, required capabilities and hard-fault rule. TTL is inclusive; eligibility timeline uses half-open end observed_at+max_age+1 for integer nanoseconds, with overflow checked.

api_contracts.name: FieldSupport
api_contracts.contract: Candidate row/origin/acquisition IDs plus admitted value only when eligible; observation, last value-change, last local receipt and liveness clocks; conservative age interval; coverage state/reasons/active incidents; exact policy/source/definition versions.

api_contracts.name: QualityDependencies
api_contracts.contract: Explicit immutable field-to-output edges compiled acyclically; mandatory versus optional ports. Propagate only relevant operations and affected intervals, preserving optional omissions and independent integrity lanes. Reuse existing Graph validation where its port/field declaration suffices; do not introduce a second hidden dependency graph.

api_contracts.name: JointPolicy / JointMovementEvidence
api_contracts.contract: Registered max observation-time span and optional max observed reference movement. Movement guard consumes explicit complete prior-data witness with interval, known_at, source evidence and exact min/max ticks; missing/partial witness cannot be inferred from sparse quotes. This batch does not implement a market path estimator.

api_contracts.name: JoinedSnapshot
api_contracts.contract: Frozen original decision cut, per-field FieldSupport, explicit joint support/reasons, compact sorted version vector and operation. Retain per-field age even when optional field omitted; no freshness reset on output creation.

api_contracts.name: EligibilityIndex
api_contracts.contract: Bounded append of immutable facts/incidents/liveness/recoveries, source-equivalent alias reconciliation, rebuild only touched field/policy timelines, binary search at cut; checkpoint binds policy/definition/source identities. Explicit capacity failures are atomic; no silent history eviction.

api_contracts.name: UniverseMember / observed_oi_coverage
api_contracts.contract: Require explicit known-time/effective-time listed universe with definition evidence. Dedup equivalent acquisitions once; report exact Fraction of quoted reported-known-OI, missing-OI count, quoted-contract count and separate coverage coordinates. No zero imputation, future membership, symbol-only identity or parent-universe manufacture.

implementation_order: Root registers exact protocol/golden/source-case hashes and combined F05–F08 code baseline/budget; no implementation before that.
Add immutable dataclasses and independent literal reference before challenger mutation code. Use existing Clocks, ContractError, canonical_json/digest and source artifacts; do not create ledgers.
Implement quality stage/incident/recovery and interval union with explicit optional-edge propagation; reuse BookReducer integration unchanged unless root assigns a discovered defect.
Materialize per-field/per-policy timelines from available source state, liveness, incidents and TTL boundaries. Add joint snapshot and explicit supplied-universe aggregation.
Write the18 named methods against frozen20 golden cases, including every output/version/age and instrumented build/query work plus fresh actual toy telemetry.
Return code for whole combined static review. One consolidated fix pass after review, then root executes combined suite under registered bounds.
materialized_interval_algorithm: Store immutable input facts by ID and per-field known-time order; duplicate equal identity is idempotent, conflict rejects before mutation. Accept reordered source admissions by rebuilding only affected timelines from the earliest changed known-time boundary.

Choose latest economic observation by observed_at, then available revision known_at/revision. Same-point payload conflicts across acquisitions fail unless byte/economic-equivalent aliases; retain all equivalent acquisition IDs. Invalidation dominates its previous same-observation revision; late older observations do not replace newer observations.

For registered field/operation policy, collect change boundaries from available fact/liveness/incident/recovery events and conservative TTL/silence endpoints. Compute immutable half-open eligibility intervals with complete diagnostic metadata. Bound both retained records and materialized intervals and check int64 endpoint overflow.

Shared-source liveness changes invalidate only timelines that declare that source policy; incident field/operation masks constrain affected timelines. Unchanged numeric values with changed source lineage remain a new interval/version; copied snapshots update local receipt metadata without changing economic/source-liveness clocks.

Query uses bisection of materialized intervals and returns complete FieldSupport. It must not call backward_reference or scan retained candidate rows. Joint span/movement and optional omission operate on those resolved fields at the original cut.

Checkpoint stores immutable originals/configuration and exact version. Restore may rebuild intervals deterministically; equality concerns published support/lineage, not physical cache layout. Changed policy/source/definition versions cannot silently reuse checkpoint.
reference_independence: Reference full scans immutable supplied facts and interval facts at each cut; shared data contracts and simple clock arithmetic are allowed, but no challenger lookup/timeline builder or selection helper is called by the reference.

numeric_fixture_rules.age: economic observed time, conservatively widened by uncertainty; no copy/receipt refresh
numeric_fixture_rules.integer_ttl: inclusive max age; materialized end is observed_at+max_age+1 with overflow guard
numeric_fixture_rules.fractions: exact rational numerator/denominator; missing denominator -> unavailable, never zero or claimed true exposure
numeric_fixture_rules.recovery: book certificate never cures historical flow support
numeric_fixture_rules.timing: actual wall/CPU/RSS measured during future controlled tests; no simulated latency reported as measured

explicit_remaining_extent: No new real market scans, original-row certification, vendor publication/condition adapter, historical liveness capture or model calibration in this batch.
SyntheticQJ03/09 age analogues do not certify original NDXP stale/future paired rows or rebuild unseen NBBO; unsupported sign remains unknown.
QJ15 scope analogue does not certify historical listing calendars. Source-specific holiday/publication and F02/F03 definition integration remain separate verified dependencies.

QJ16 capability declarations preserve limitations; they do not implement OPRA probabilistic signing, option Greeks/dealer/opening inference, roll choice, macro vintages, new source acquisitions or all40 original cohort cases.
QJ20 establishes finite dependency-local repair semantics; complete raw replay through production bars/profiles/surfaces and all downstream C/O/X/L/G/P consumers remains P5 work.
No statistical liveness/changepoint/learned-imputation challenger. Prior-only calibration and reviewed false-alert rates remain later P2/P3 comparisons.
INV12 original historical hardware transcript unresolved; INV11 original216-row semantic scope not closed. Existing original evidence is reused only at its documented extent.
P6 complete E0–E5 economics and P7 actual future capture/parity are not closed by engineering tests.
